title: GRFBrain: Graph-Structured Rectified Flows for EEG Dynamic Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2609.37934v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecasting time-varying functional connectivity from electroencephalography (EEG) requires modeling both history-dependent trends and structured variability across channels. Conditional flow matching provides a framework for distributional forecasting, yet it remains unclear whether graph-informed source distributions offer practical advantages over isotropic noise and strong deterministic predictors. We introduce a graph-structured residual flow framework that separates conditional mean prediction from stochastic residual transport. A history-only predictor estimates the future connectivity graph, while a graph Gaussian source encodes dependencies derived from past connectivity through a Laplacian-based covariance. A conditional velocity field transports source samples to future graph residuals, with transport time explicitly distinguished from physical EEG time. Our study identifies the conditions and controls needed to distinguish us

translated_title: GRFBrain：面向脑电（EEG）动态建模的图结构校正流
translated_abstract: 从脑电图（EEG）预测时变功能连接需要同时对历史依赖的趋势和跨通道的结构化变异性进行建模。条件流匹配为分布预测提供了一个框架，然而基于图的源分布相对于各向同性噪声和强确定性预测器是否具有实际优势仍不清楚。我们提出了一种图结构残差流框架，将条件均值预测与随机残差输运分离开来。一个仅依赖历史信息的预测器用于估计未来的连接图，而图高斯源则通过基于拉普拉斯算子的协方差来编码从过去连接性中导出的通道间依赖关系。条件速度场将源样本输运到未来的图残差上，其中输运时间与物理脑电时间被明确区分开来。我们的研究识别出了区分……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出GRFBrain框架，通过图结构残差流将条件均值预测与随机残差输运分离，并利用图高斯源编码历史连接依赖，实现了对脑电时变功能连接的概率分布预测。
